value.exempt: a creative professional paid a salary or fee of at least USD 455 a week (§ 3108(b)(3))

sources.title: Guam Code Annotated, 22 GCA Ch. 3 Fair Labor Standards (COL08222024)
sources.said: § 3105. Minimum Wages. Every employer shall pay each person employed by him wages at a rate not less than Eight Dollars and Twenty-Five Cents ($8.25) per hour, effective January 1, 2015; not less than Eight Dollars and Seventy-Five Cents ($8.75) per hour, effective March 1, 2020; and not less than Nine Dollars and Twenty-Five Cents ($9.25) per hour, effective September 1, 2021.

found.notes: A statutory wage floor, not a stage agreement: it binds only where the actor is employed (not a fee-paid professional over USD 455 a week). The same floor stands for a stage director (item 7) who is employed.
